newsitem.title: FRANCE: ALPINE SKIING-SNOW DELAYS START OF GIANT SLALOM.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-SNOW DELAYS START OF GIANT SLALOM.

text.p: Heavy snow fell on the French Alps on Friday morning, forcing organisers to postpone the start of a women's World Cup Alpine skiing giant slalom.

A men's downhill practice scheduled for Friday afternoon was cancelled because of the weather and lack of visibility at the top of the OK piste. Officials said no decision had yet been made about Saturday's downhill race.
Italian Sabina Panzanini, winner of the last giant slalom held in Park City, Utah, last month, had been due to ski first in the women's race at 0830 GMT.
But the start was put back twice as snow continued to fall steadily.
Heavy snowfalls forced the cancellation of the first men's downhill of the season in Whistler, British Columbia, earlier this month.
